method: Sides: das_staff/mayor/das_system one side; citizen, supplier, AJPIS, owner association and other offices each their own; generated actor 'unknown' may match any side. A rule/amount alone does not match a step. 'merged' = one claim covers this reference step together with another reference step; 'partial' = claim(s) cover only part of the step. order_checks: (predecessor, step) pairs from the reference predecessor lists, in reference order, where both steps are matched; claims shared by both steps are removed (pair skipped if a side becomes empty); same_order is true if a directed path over the ledger 'order' statements leads from a claim of the first step to a claim of the second and is no longer than any reverse path, false if only (or a shorter) reverse path exists, 'not_connected' otherwise.
